jobs.occupation: Internship within Aerodynamic Machine Learning (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Loads & Aeroelastics department, Airbus Operations is offering anInternship within Aerodynamic Machine Learning (d/f/m)Are you looking for a mandatory internship and want to get to know the work of a Guts Loads Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Loads & Aeroelastics department as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Hamburg- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 6 months- Are you passionate about aircraft physics?Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to maneuvers, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?Do you like to work in an empowered manner?Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces?This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.About usWe are a team of 17 multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modeling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning.Your locationYou will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.FinkenwerderAre you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.Your benefits- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilitiesDuring this six months internship you will develop methods based on machine learning in order to obtain the pressure fields due to a gust event. You will compare the results versus the non-linear results.- Optimize the global design of Airbus products during the concept phases- Build and develop methods to consider nonlinearities inside an Aeroelastic model- Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journeyDesired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Engineering, Physics, Maths, Data science or an equivalent field of study.- You have strong knowledge and experience in Aerodynamics and CFD.- You have strong knowledge and experience in coding using Python and/or Matlab.- Knowledge and experience with training of machine learning models .- You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgment.- Your English is at negotiating level whereas German language skills would be beneficial.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Engineer for Aerodynamics (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Elektromobilität)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the flight physics department, Airbus Operations in Bremen is looking for severalEngineer for Aerodynamics (d/f/m)Are you interested in understanding the physics of flight?Are you thrilled to shape the next generation of aircraft products and digital services?Would you like to drive aerodynamic design and characterisation?Do you embrace diversity and enjoy empowerment?Then join us in Aerodynamics!There has never been a more exciting time to join commercial aircraft at Airbus. The future is changing and we are working on innovative aircraft technologies, configurations and propulsion systems to meet those ambitions.Within the Airbus Flight Physics transnational centre, the successful applicant will join our Aircraft Aerodynamics team based in Bremen, Germany.The team is responsible for the aerodynamic characterization of the overall aircraft for all Airbus programmes. We generate models representing aerodynamics for customers in aircraft loads, aircraft performance and handling qualities. In that we contribute to the design, optimisation and validation of external aircraft shapes, structure and systems.We engage from the early design stage, update and validate design and data through numerical simulation, wind-tunnel testing and flight-test.The challenge of more sustainable aviation requires us to evolve our aerodynamic design and characterization. It can only be tackled in new ways of working, with new digital capabilities and with your curiosity, openness and imagination! This, and a high degree of reliability mixed with an agile mindset are key to achieving our ambitious goals. Strong technical expertise and a rigorous application of safety-relevant processes are fundamental prerequisites.Your locationBremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany.
